description: FREE. Expands one step of an emit_app recipe: the full instruction, why it matters, how to know it worked, and what to do when it did not. emit_app returns steps in short form to stay inside the response budget, so this carries the detail for any step that needs it. Step "write" also lists every file (path, origin, bytes), and "review" returns the screen list; both come a page at a time when long. Needs the same share code and the step's id.

appId.description: the share code you passed to emit_app

page.description: which page of the file list (write) or the screen list (review); omit for the first. Each page names the next.

stepId.description: the step id, e.g. "configure" or "write", or "review" for the screen list

name: get_step
title: Expand a recipe step
